task_instance: Implement a mobile-first responsive dashboard page (index.html) that exercises the skill's core patterns: fluid typography/spacing with CSS clamp(), a page layout built on CSS Grid named areas with min-width breakpoints, an auto-fit card grid, component-level container queries, a sidebar nav that appears only at the desktop breakpoint, dynamic viewport (dvh) height, 44px touch targets, and a horizontally scrollable responsive table.
evidence: Read SKILL.md and references/details.md from the skill repo. Wrote index.html (~140 lines) applying the documented patterns, plus verify.mjs which drives the runtime-provided headless browser (playwright-core with the chromium bundled under /opt) to load the page at viewport widths 375, 768, 1024 and 1440 and measure computed layout. Ran `node verify.mjs`. Verified results: (1) no horizontal overflow at any width (scrollWidth == clientWidth: 375/375, 768/768, 1024/1024, 1440/1440) -- the skill's #1 Common Issue avoided after adding min-width:0 to grid items; (2) page grid tracks adapt from a single column (375) to main+sidebar two columns (768) to nav+main+sidebar three columns (1024 and 1440), read from gridTemplateColumns; (3) the sidebar nav computes display:none below 1024 and display:block at 1024+ (mobile-first breakpoint), fixed a source-order bug that was hiding it; (4) the auto-fit card grid reflows from 1 column at narrow widths to 3 columns at 1440; (5) container queries function independent of viewport -- a card's computed display is grid when its container is >=320px (single-column 375 view) and falls back to flex when the container is narrow (multi-column 1440 view), proving component-level responsiveness. clamp() fluid type/space scale, 100dvh, and 44px touch targets are present in the CSS. Screenshots captured: shot_375.png, shot_768.png, shot_1024.png, shot_1440.png. Files in work dir: index.html, verify.mjs, result.json, shot_*.png.
